definitions.explanation: The force of attraction or repulsion produced by magnets or magnetic fields. Also used figuratively to describe a powerful attraction.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{磁石|じしゃく}→磁石：04211_jishaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{磁力|じりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This magnet has strong magnetic force.

examples.japanese: {磁力|じりょく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{寄|よ}せる→引き寄せる：06046_hikiyoseru⟧。
examples.english: It attracts metal with magnetic force.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ→時間が経つ：24138_jikangatatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{磁力|じりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}く→弱い：00825_yowai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Over time, the magnetic force can weaken.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {磁|じ} (magnet, magnetic) + {力|りょく} (force, power). Used in science, technology, and everyday descriptions of magnets. Occasionally used figuratively to describe an irresistible pull or attraction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {磁力|じりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧ (strong magnetic force)
- {磁力|じりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ (weak magnetic force)
- {磁力線|じりょくせん} (magnetic lines of force)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{磁気|じき}→磁気：03334_jiki⟧: magnetism — the broader phenomenon or property
- ⟦{引力|いんりょく}→引力：25274_inryoku⟧: gravitational pull, attraction — a different kind of force
